setting.culture: A Muslim family in Lahore; a walled courtyard, a brass bell by the gate, pigeons on the roof.

data.title: Danyal and the Bell

premise.hero_want: Danyal wants to make the brass bell sound.
premise.mechanism: Danyal pulls the red loop, making the bell swing and sound.
premise.resolution: The bell makes a big din, and Danyal is glad.

key_objects.name: Brass bell
key_objects.description: A small brass bell fixed beside the courtyard gate.

key_objects.name: Red pull loop
key_objects.description: A short red fabric loop hanging from the bell, low enough for Danyal to reach.

cast.who: Danyal, a five-year-old Pakistani boy in Lahore
cast.appearance: Warm brown skin, short black hair and solid black filled oval eyes. He wears a long-sleeved teal kurta, loose cream shalwar and brown sandals. His shoulders and knees are covered.

pages.text: Danyal is at the bell. The bell is still.
pages.scene: In one walled Lahore courtyard, Danyal stands beside the green gate and looks at the brass bell. The red pull loop hangs below it. A few pigeons sit on the roof. All visible eyes, including the pigeons’ eyes, are solid black filled ovals.

pages.text: Danyal has a plan. He can pull it.
pages.scene: In the same spot, Danyal smiles and points to the red pull loop. The brass bell is still, and the pigeons remain on the roof. All visible eyes, including the pigeons’ eyes, are solid black filled ovals.

pages.text: Pull, pull! The bell can jig.
pages.scene: Danyal safely pulls the red loop with both hands. The brass bell begins to swing. The pigeons stay on the roof. All visible eyes, including the pigeons’ eyes, are solid black filled ovals.

pages.text: The bell is not still. A big din!
pages.scene: The brass bell swings above Danyal, with simple motion and sound lines. Danyal still holds the red loop. The pigeons lift their heads on the roof. All visible eyes, including the pigeons’ eyes, are solid black filled ovals.
Danyal nods under the gently swinging bell, still holding the red loop. The pigeons remain together on the roof. All visible eyes, including the pigeons’ eyes, are solid black filled ovals.

pages.text: Danyal is glad. He can pull the bell!
pages.scene: Danyal gives the red loop one last gentle pull and smiles as the brass bell swings. The pigeons stay on the roof above him. All visible eyes, including the pigeons’ eyes, are solid black filled ovals.

data.cold_read: The story passes the blocking checks. Danyal notices the still bell, decides what to do and causes the result by pulling one loop. The action is safe, the text and scenes agree, and the story stays in one location with two key objects and one mechanism. The phonics and read_words requirements are met. A few lines are stiff, so the final version smooths them without adding story beats.

issues.detail: “Danyal has a plan. Danyal can pull it.” repeats the name and sounds caption-like. Direct speech makes Danyal’s decision more natural.
“Danyal can nod” and “The bell is fun” are flat, procedural lines. A grin and a final child-led statement provide a warmer finish without adding a new beat.
